title: A paused run resumes on its checkpointed context and re-verifies safety inputs
risk: A resumed run re-hydrates a different context, so the action approved by a human no longer matches what is executed.
preconditions: Run orc-resume-* paused at step 2 of 3 with a checkpointed context and an approved action in namespace orc-resume-*
ERP data changed after the pause while consent and authority inputs stayed valid

steps.action: Resume the paused run from its checkpoint
steps.expected: execution continues at step 2 with the checkpointed context identity, and step 1 is not re-executed

steps.action: Compare the context used at resume with the checkpoint snapshot
steps.expected: customer identity, session and consent inputs are identical; only refreshed operational reads differ and they are re-verified before use

steps.action: Change a safety input (consent withdrawn) between pause and resume, then resume again
steps.expected: the step is blocked at the pre-step re-verification and the run does not dispatch

steps.action: Read the audit trail for the run
steps.expected: the pause, the resume and the block each appear with their timestamps and the context reference used

assertions: Resume continues from step 2 without repeating step 1 or re-deciding the routing
The resumed context references the checkpointed context identity and re-verifies safety inputs before dispatch
Withdrawn consent blocks the resumed dispatch and records the reason
forbidden: Re-hydrate a fresh context and silently substitute it for the approved one
Re-execute an already completed step after resume
evidence: Checkpoint context reference and the context hash at pause and at resume
Audit entries for pause, resume and the blocked dispatch
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped checkpoint and task rows for orc-resume-*; keep audit entries
automation: Pause and resume the real durable task with a deterministic clock; safety inputs are mutated through the real consent service so the block is observable.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
